comment: Index order is not panel order: the transpose input is index 8 but sits at the top of the middle column, and the two accent outputs are indices 6 and 7 but sit in the middle column of the output section. Every port has a jack. The maker's manual describes the inputs as overriding the internal sequencer, which is what the code does, but it does not say that a slide input is read as a one-sample flag rather than a length, so a held slide gate glides every step it covers.
